designDecisions.roster: _catalog/texas_roster_v1.json (schema t6_roster_v1, generated_at 2026-08-12T16:47:05.273Z, last_updated 2026-08-12T21:39:21Z). 1223 incorporated cities statewide with all_county_fips, from the T6 recon. Chosen over tx_city_boundary because the RO role cannot see tx_city_boundary (see instrumentLimits) and because the roster carries the zoning-layer probe record per city, which the boundary table does not.
designDecisions.rosterLimit: The roster's record_type is 'city' only. CDPs, unincorporated communities and postal-only places are NOT in it. That gap is itself a finding and is reported, not silently absorbed.
designDecisions.setbackTables: legacy-design-tools lib/adapters/src/local/setbacks/*.json + index.ts SETBACK_TABLES at origin/main. Registration in SETBACK_TABLES, not mere file presence, is the test.
designDecisions.parcelBinding: landing_parcel_jurisdiction is NOT visible to the read-only role. Substitute: parcel_record_cell rail_key='zoningJurisdictionKey', whose cell_state carries {kind:'value', value:'<cityKey>'} or {kind:'not-applicable'} / unaccounted. This is the SERVING binding, which is the stronger measurement for this question; it is a different instrument from landing_parcel_jurisdiction and is labelled as such in every row.

instrumentLimits: parcel_record_ro can SELECT exactly four tables: parcel_record, parcel_record_cell, parcel_record_companion_row, parcel_gate_verdict. tx_city_boundary, tx_zoning_district_staging and landing_parcel_jurisdiction are NOT reachable from this credential.
Verified by violation 2026-09-13: BEGIN; INSERT INTO parcel_record ... -> 'ERROR:  permission denied for table parcel_record'. The role refuses writes at the database, not at a code check.
parcel_record.place_key is the PARCEL identity (<countyFips>:<propId>), NOT a place key. Do not read it as a city binding.
